core: Erythrocyte heme synthesis and gas transport
qualifier: Rhesus ammonium and CO2 transport
name: Erythrocyte heme synthesis and gas/ammonium transport
rationale: Members cover heme biosynthesis, iron handling and red-cell O2/CO2/NO transport, plus Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, which the iron-scavenging, transferrin and Fe-S cluster confusables lack.

qualifier: central nervous system oligodendrocytes and glial proliferation
name: CNS oligodendrocyte myelination and glial proliferation control
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte differentiation, CNS myelin formation/maintenance and glial proliferation/gliosis, whereas confusables emphasise Schwann-cell/PNS myelin, nodal assembly, axon regeneration or glial fate specification.

qualifier: coronavirus targeting of host signalling and PDZ proteins
name: Viral protein maturation and coronavirus host-pathway targeting
rationale: Members are maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host signalling/PDZ proteins, while confusables centre on viral attachment and entry.

qualifier: FLT3 mutant TKI resistance and EPO/TPO-STAT5
name: FLT3 mutant TKI resistance and EPO/TPO-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are FLT3 signaling and its TKI-resistant mutants plus erythropoietin/thrombopoietin/G-CSF STAT5 signaling, distinguishing them from ALK, KIT, PDGFR, FGFR and ERBB2 mutant-resistance confusables.

qualifier: dietary lipid digestion and lipase activation
name: Dietary lipid digestion and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members cover lipid digestion, lipase and phospholipid catabolism, and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, while confusables address lipoprotein clearance, remodeling, HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: inhibition of ruffling, spreading and epithelial migration
name: Leading-edge actin protrusion with ruffle and spreading inhibition
rationale: Members promote lamellipodia, pseudopodia and actin polymerization at the leading edge while restraining ruffles, cell spreading and epithelial migration, unlike confusables focused on Arp2/3 nucleation, severing or contraction.

qualifier: epithelial lineages, alveologenesis and lactation
name: Mammary epithelial lineages, alveologenesis and lactation
rationale: Members describe mammary stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar lineages, alveolus development and lactation, whereas confusables cover ductal branching, involution or prostate/reproductive tract development.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis
rationale: All members concern formyl peptide receptor signaling and granulocyte/neutrophil chemotaxis, while confusables cover extravasation, degranulation and general myeloid activation.

qualifier: hair follicle, tooth, gland and pigment cell development
name: Ectodermal appendage development: hair, teeth, glands, melanocytes
rationale: Members cover hair follicle, tooth, sebaceous/mammary gland, nail, taste papilla and melanocyte development from ectoderm, distinguishing them from keratinocyte cornification and skin-barrier confusables.

qualifier: entry through reverse transcription and integration
name: HIV-1 early replication: entry, reverse transcription, integration
rationale: Members trace HIV-1 binding, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, circle formation and integration, while confusables concern APOBEC editing, HCMV latency or influenza transcription.

qualifier: response to activity, inactivity and atrophy
name: Skeletal muscle adaptation to activity and atrophy
rationale: Members concern muscle homeostasis, growth and atrophy in response to use and disuse, whereas confusables cover myogenesis, regeneration and cardiac muscle adaptation.

qualifier: NF-kB-driven dendritic cell and TNF/IL-23 output
name: NF-kB-driven myeloid and dendritic cell inflammatory activation
rationale: Members are myeloid/dendritic cell NF-kB activation and TNF/IL-23 inflammatory output modules, unlike confusables on NK cytokines, T cell regulation, inflammation suppression or monocyte chemokines.

qualifier: IL-10 and IL-12 cytokine families
name: Immunoregulatory IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-10, IL-20 family, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signaling and IL-10 production, distinguishing them from IL-17/Dectin, broad JAK-STAT and NK/interferon confusables.

qualifier: repair DNA synthesis in SDSA and break-induced replication
name: Repair DNA synthesis in recombinational double-strand break repair
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding and repair synthesis in synthesis-dependent strand annealing, break-induced replication and sister chromatid exchange, unlike confusables on NHEJ, BRCA signaling or checkpoints.

qualifier: snoRNP assembly and telomerase RNA Cajal body localization
name: RNA modification, snoRNP assembly and telomerase Cajal-body localization
rationale: Members cover rRNA/tRNA/mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation, snoRNP assembly and scaRNA/telomerase RNA Cajal body targeting, unlike confusables on RNA decay, mitochondrial RNA or transcription and splicing.

qualifier: deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain editing, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover linkage-specific ubiquitination and deubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/COP9 and proteasome assembly, while confusables emphasise protein quality control, autophagy and degradation regulation.

qualifier: erythropoietin, CSF1 and LTK/ALK receptors
name: Erythropoietin, CSF1 and LTK/ALK receptor PI3K-AKT/ERK signaling
rationale: Members are PI3K-AKT, RAS-ERK, PLCG and STAT5 signaling downstream of EPO/TPO, interleukin, CSF1 and LTK/ALK receptors, distinguishing them from MET, IGF1R/IRS and oncogenic RTK fusion confusables.

qualifier: proinflammatory cytokine induction
name: Toll-like receptor signaling regulation and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signaling and promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables on inflammasomes, TAK1/IKK mechanics or cytokine suppression.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply, N-/O-glycans, sialylation and fucosylation
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and N-/O-glycan and glycolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover nucleotide sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialic acid and fucose metabolism, glycosphingolipids and their congenital disorders, unlike GPI-anchor or lysosomal catabolism confusables.

qualifier: ischemic and hypoxic response
name: ATP-sensitive potassium channels and ischemic response
rationale: Members are KATP channels (ABCC8/ABCC9 defects) and responses to ischemia, oxygen and hydrogen sulfide, distinguishing them from two-pore K+ channel, oxidative stress and purinergic confusables.

qualifier: acylglycerol and N-acylethanolamine hydrolysis with retrograde signaling
name: Endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis and retrograde synaptic signaling
rationale: Members cover DAG/MAG, NAPE/NAE and lysophospholipid hydrolysis feeding endocannabinoid retrograde signaling, unlike confusables on acylglycerol synthesis, lipid transfer or acyl-chain remodeling.

qualifier: SGLT and GLUT2 transporters and their defects
name: SGLT- and GLUT2-mediated hexose transport and disorders
rationale: Members are cellular and intestinal hexose transport and SLC5A1/SLC5A2/SLC2A2 deficiency syndromes, distinguishing them from disaccharide digestion, fructose/urate and anion transporter confusables.

qualifier: TRAIL/TNF signaling and necrosis suppression
name: Death-receptor apoptosis regulation via TRAIL/TNF and necrosis suppression
rationale: Members regulate extrinsic death-receptor apoptosis via TRAIL and TNF, execution-phase apoptosis and programmed necrosis, unlike confusables centred on TNFR1-NF-kB, caspase-8 machinery or Fas in T cells.

qualifier: lung and exocrine glands via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis of lung and glands
rationale: Members cover lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal branching morphogenesis driven by epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, unlike kidney, pancreatic or reproductive-tract confusables.

qualifier: terminal red cell maturation and enucleation
name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and late erythroid membrane remodeling and enucleation, unlike confusables on stem/progenitor homeostasis, heme metabolism or megakaryocytic branching.
